# eCloudBridge

eCloudBridge Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a DevOps and cloud solutions company based in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. 
We specialize in cloud migration (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes management, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevSecOps, FinOps, and CI/CD automation.

- Year Founded: 2021

## Services Provided
- Cloud Migration
- DevOps & CI/CD
- Kubernetes Architecture & Management
- Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
- DevSecOps & Security
- FinOps (Cloud Cost Optimization)

## Products
- Netpin.io (https://netpin.io): Infrastructure Debt Index (IDI) platform for tracking technical debt.
- Astra: Intelligent cloud observability and monitoring platform.
